# Bending Spoons agrees $1\.28bn all-cash Airtable deal in first post-IPO Bending Spoons S\.p\.A\. \(NASDAQ: BSP\), the Milan-based digital rollup that listed on Nasdaq on 1 July 2026, has agreed to acquire Airtable in an all-cash transaction valuing the U\.S\. workflow software company at an enterprise value of $1\.285 billion, or an implied equity value of approximately $2\.25 billion once Airtable’s net cash balance is factored in\. The transaction, unanimously approved by both boards, marks Bending Spoons’ first acquisition since its Nasdaq debut and follows a January purchase of AOL and a March purchase of Eventbrite that were financed before the initial public offering\. Completion is expected before the end of 2026, subject to regulatory review and customary closing conditions\.
